title: STM32-class Reflex controller
tables: A deterministic microcontroller and safety I/O layer independent of the AI operating system.
Runs temperature/humidity control, light triggers, motor limits, door/UV interlocks, watchdogs and fault shutdown.
A Linux crash, AI overload or update must not disable basic safety or sample protection.
Industrial MCU class offers deterministic timing, mature peripherals, hardware watchdogs and long-term embedded support.
